ETS-Lindgren
ETS-LindgrenRequest A Quote
 Glendale Heights, IL 
ETS-Lindgren is a renowned global leader in the field of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and EMI shielding solutions. With a rich history spanning several decades, the company has built a strong reputation for providing high-quality products and services to a wide range of industries. 
At the core of ETS-Lindgren's offerings is their comprehensive line of EMI shielding products. These include shielded enclosures, chambers, and rooms, RF absorbers, conductive gaskets, EMI filters, and shielding materials. These products are designed to effectively mitigate electromagnetic interference and provide a shielded environment for sensitive electronic equipment and systems. 
ETS-Lindgren's shielded enclosures and chambers are constructed with precision and attention to detail, ensuring optimal shielding effectiveness and performance. They are designed to meet various standards and specifications, such as MIL-STD, IEC, and FCC requirements, and can be customized to accommodate specific customer needs. These enclosures provide a controlled electromagnetic environment, enabling accurate testing, measurement, and characterization of electronic devices. 
The company's RF absorbers play a crucial role in creating anechoic chambers and absorbing unwanted RF energy. ETS-Lindgren offers a wide range of absorber materials, including pyramidal, hybrid, and broadband absorbers, to address different frequency ranges and applications. These absorbers effectively reduce reflections and eliminate unwanted electromagnetic waves, enabling precise testing and measurement of devices. 
ETS-Lindgren also specializes in the design and manufacturing of high-performance EMI filters. These filters are essential for attenuating unwanted electromagnetic noise and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. The company offers a diverse range of filters, including power line filters, signal line filters, feedthrough filters, and custom-designed filters, tailored to meet specific customer requirements. 
Furthermore, ETS-Lindgren provides a comprehensive suite of services to support their customers' EMI shielding needs. Their experienced team of engineers and technical experts offers consulting, design, and installation services for shielded enclosures, chambers, and rooms. They work closely with clients to develop customized solutions that address unique shielding challenges. Additionally, ETS-Lindgren offers testing and certification services to verify the performance of shielding installations and ensure compliance with industry standards. 
With a global presence, ETS-Lindgren serves a wide range of industries, including aerospace, defense, telecommunications, automotive, medical, and consumer electronics. Their EMI shielding solutions have been trusted by major corporations, government agencies, and research institutions worldwide. 
ETS-Lindgren's commitment to quality is evident in their adherence to rigorous manufacturing standards and certifications. The company maintains ISO 9001 certification, ensuring that their products and services consistently meet the highest quality standards. Their state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and advanced testing equipment enable precise control and verification of product performance. 
In summary, ETS-Lindgren is a leading provider of EMI shielding solutions with a comprehensive product portfolio and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. Their expertise in EMC, precision engineering, and industry-leading technologies make them a trusted partner for customers seeking effective EMI shielding solutions. With their innovative products, customized solutions, and comprehensive service offerings, ETS-Lindgren continues to drive advancements in the field of electromagnetic compatibility and help customers achieve optimal performance and reliability in their electronic systems.
